      "kind": "approach",
      "harm": "Failing scans unconditionally when the index is behind the tip breaks scans for ranges that are already available.",
      "quote": "There we don't fail unconditionally if the index isn't synced. We only fail if we the range isn't available.",
      "blocking": true,
      "status": "resolved",
      "author_replies": ["c:5181858801"],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "settled_by_id": "c:5181858801",
      "settled_by_quote": "You're right - thanks. getblockfilter does not fail merely because index is behind the tip, so it fails when the requested filter isn't available"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4041798369",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "harm": "The functional test relies on races, skips testing under race conditions, and mines an excessive number of blocks.",
      "quote": "No normal functional test should require mining this many blocks. And we don't leave the actual testing to chance. The test either needs to work deterministically or it is of no use for us",

      "status": "open",

      "substantive": true
    }
  ],
  "notes": "maflcko and fjahr Concept ACKed the PR. fjahr's initial objection regarding unconditional failure was resolved with an updated approach, but fjahr left open objections regarding test determinism and cached index readiness."
}
